summary: This document outlines the requirements for building a responsive single-page application that interacts with a public classroom API. The app must allow users to view the current list of signups and submit their own name via specific GET and POST endpoints.
key_facts: GET /api/signups returns all signups, newest first.
POST /api/signups requires a JSON body: { "name": "Ada Lovelace" }.
Successful GET response includes a 'signups' array, e.g., { "signups": [{ "name": "Ada Lovelace" }] }.
Successful POST response returns status 201 and { "signup": { "name": "Ada Lovelace" } }.
Error codes to handle include 400 (invalid body), 409 (name already signed up), and 500 (service problem).
